description: Use this when someone asks to add a new patient to their dental practice. Returns the patient's id, name, practice and language; the phone and email given are saved but never returned, and nothing clinical is taken. Not for changing an existing patient.

clinicId.description: Id of the practice, from list_clinics. Leave it out when the user has one practice.

language.description: Language for their messages, as a code such as en, it or pt-BR. Defaults to the practice language.

phone.description: Mobile number, with the country code when known.

requestId.description: A unique id you choose for this patient, such as a UUID. Calling again with the same requestId returns the first patient instead of adding a second one.

name: create_patient
title: Add a dental patient
